title: Global Warming Potential set
description: A single, citable set of GWP values (one IPCC assessment report, one time horizon).

id.description: Stable identifier; must match a member of the GwpSet enum (e.g. Ar5, Ar6).

timeHorizonYears.description: GHG Protocol corporate reporting uses the 100-year horizon.

includesClimateCarbonFeedback.description: IPCC publishes GWP values with and without climate-carbon feedback. GHG Protocol inventories use the values WITHOUT feedback; mixing the two silently changes results.

gas.description: Must match a member of the GreenhouseGas enum.

sourceTable.description: The exact table this value was read from, when a set draws on more than one table of the same report. AR6 is the case in point: its headline metrics table covers only a few species, and the rest come from the supplementary table.

title.description: Cite the exact table, not just the report (e.g. 'AR6 WG1 Ch.7, Table 7.SM.7').

license.description: Redistribution terms for these values. A set with no clear licence must not ship.

status.description: Only 'verified' sets are allowed into a release build. See tools/verify-catalog.

method.description: How the values were checked against the primary source.

inputs.description: For a set whose values are computed rather than read off a page: every input the arithmetic consumed, so a reader can redo it without re-running the importer or trusting a live API to still answer the same way.

sourceUrls.description: The exact endpoint each input came from, keyed by the name it has under 'inputs'.
